admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: A word about the linen cupboard, from the linen keeper, who posted this notice and is glad to answer questions about the new arrangement. You will find a small change on the landing from the next washing day onward, and it seemed kind to explain it before anyone goes looking for a pillowslip in the usual place. The housekeeping circle, at its washing-day sitting, decided that the second shelf of the landing cupboard should hold guest linens only, with the house linens moving down to the third shelf, and the decision is entered in the house book in the usual way. There is no mystery in it: guests arrive at odd hours, and it is pleasant for whoever greets them to reach the right shelf without a candle-lit search. The shelf cards will be rewritten before the change takes effect, so the labels will tell the truth on the day itself. The change applies to the landing cupboard alone, and nothing else in the cupboard moves; every other shelf stays exactly as it has always been, which is surely how a cupboard prefers things.
